headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.title_en: Two ministries: By 2030, the proportion of large modern coal mine capacity nationwide will rise to 87%
headlines.summary_en: China's National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration have issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Coal Industry. It notes that by 2030, coal's role as a basic safeguard will be further enhanced, production and development layout continuously optimized, the share of high-quality advanced production capacity further raised, and the production-supply-storage-marketing system improved, with the share of large modern coal mines rising to 87%. Safe and green development and clean, efficient utilization will be significantly improved, intelligent construction across the industry advanced, and the proportion of intelligent coal mine capacity increased to 75%. A diversified coal-based industrial pattern will accelerate, coal consumption will peak, the dynamic supply-demand balance guarantee mechanism will be further improved, modern governance capacity in the industry notably enhanced, and a modern coal industry system basically completed, bringing high-quality coal development to a new level.

headlines.summary_zh:

headlines.title_en: A-share market close: Shanghai Composite Index rises 0.67% for a fifth consecutive gain, with pharmaceutical and consumer stocks performing strongly
headlines.summary_en: The market fluctuated throughout the day with mixed results across the three major indices. Consumer stocks such as food strengthened, with Huangs Group, Xiangpiaopiao, Yiming Food and others hitting limit-up. Pharmaceutical stocks continued gains, with Baihua Pharmaceutical rising five consecutive limit-ups, and Asia-Pacific Pharmaceutical, Hayao Group and others also hitting limit-up. Gold stocks fluctuated higher, with Zhaojin Gold, Chaohongji, Mankaron and others at limit-up. The military sector was active, with Hongdu Aviation, Hunan Tianyan, Great Wall Military and others hitting limit-up. On the downside, computing hardware stocks such as PCB and CPO declined, with Toben New Energy falling over 8%. Gainers outnumbered losers, with over 4,000 stocks rising across Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing exchanges, with turnover near 2.54 trillion yuan today. At close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.67%, Shenzhen Component gained 0.04%, and ChiNext fell 0.73%.

headlines.title: 依顿电子：控股股东九洲集团首次增持330万股
headlines.summary: 依顿电子公告，控股股东四川九洲投资控股集团有限公司于2026年8月10日通过上海证券交易所集中竞价交易方式首次增持公司股份330万股，占公司总股本比例约为0.33%，增持金额为人民币3784.25万元。根据此前披露的增持计划，九洲集团拟自2026年8月8日起3个月内增持公司股份，累计增持数量不低于总股本的1%且不超过总股本的2%。本次增持前，九洲集团持有公司股份3亿股，占公司总股本的30.00000%。

headlines.title_en: Yidun Electronics: Controlling shareholder Jiuzhou Group increases holdings by 3.3 million shares for the first time
headlines.summary_en: Yidun Electronics announced that its controlling shareholder, Sichuan Jiuzhou Investment Holding Group Co., Ltd., on August 10, 2026, first increased its shareholding in the company by 3.3 million shares via centralized bidding on the Shanghai Stock Exchange, accounting for approximately 0.33% of total share capital, with an increase amount of 37.8425 million yuan. According to the previously disclosed increase plan, Jiuzhou Group plans to increase its shareholding within three months from August 8, 2026, with cumulative increase of no less than 1% and no more than 2% of total share capital. Before this increase, Jiuzhou Group held 300 million shares, representing 30.00000% of total share capital.

headlines.title_en: Shanghai: Promote expanded overseas access to computing power and foundational large models, support exports of model products such as agents and multimodal generation
headlines.summary_en: Shanghai Municipal Commission of Commerce and six other departments have issued the Shanghai National Service Trade Innovation Development Demonstration Zone Construction Plan. It calls for attracting enterprises and institutions to set up AI R&D centers, open-source platforms and collaborative labs. It promotes expanded overseas invocation of computing power and foundational large models, supporting export of model products such as agents and multimodal generation. It encourages embodied intelligence and other intelligent terminal companies to expand new full-lifecycle service models. It supports AI empowerment of healthcare, education, professional services and other industries. It plans to host the World Artificial Intelligence Conference and global developer events, accelerating construction of the headquarters of the World AI Cooperation Organization. It supports Pudong New Area in building an AI innovation application pilot zone and Xuhui District in developing a large-model innovation ecosystem community. It also explores establishing a global AI governance system.

headlines.title: 两部门：持续推进现代煤炭市场建设
headlines.summary: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中提到，积极发展全国统一煤炭交易市场，完善基础制度和规则，健全信息共享机制，进一步发挥全国煤炭交易中心作用。完善电煤保供中长期合同制度，推进煤炭交易合同规范化标准化，加强合同签约履约监管。健全煤炭市场价格形成机制，结合市场形势和成本变化适时完善煤炭价格区间调控政策，规范价格指数行为。

headlines.title_en: Two ministries: Continue advancing the construction of a modern coal market
headlines.summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration have issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Coal Industry. It mentions actively developing a unified national coal trading market, improving foundational systems and rules, enhancing information-sharing mechanisms, and further leveraging the role of the national coal trading center. It improves long-term contract mechanisms for coal power supply assurance, promotes standardization of coal trading contracts, and strengthens contract signing and performance supervision. It improves the coal price formation mechanism, timely refining coal price range control policies based on market conditions and cost changes, and regulating price index behavior.

headlines.title_en: Haiyou New Materials: Plans to inject 45 million yuan into wholly-owned subsidiary Taizhou Haiyouwei
headlines.summary_en: Haiyou New Materials announced that it plans to increase capital in its wholly-owned subsidiary Taizhou Haiyouwei Applied Materials Co., Ltd. by 45 million yuan using自有资金 or self-raised funds. The capital increase has been approved by the company's 38th Board meeting and does not require shareholder approval. After completion, Taizhou Haiyouwei's registered capital will increase from 150 million yuan to 195 million yuan, with the company maintaining 100% ownership. This capital increase does not constitute a related-party transaction or major asset restructuring.

headlines.title_en: Xiandao Jidian: The company's current main business does not include indium phosphide substrate business, nor does it have related revenue or profits
headlines.summary_en: Xiandao Jidian announced that the closing price of Shanghai Xiandao Jidian Technology Co., Ltd. accumulated a deviation of 20% over three consecutive trading days, constituting abnormal trading fluctuations under the Shanghai Stock Exchange Trading Rules. The company noted recent media reports and market rumors mentioning that the company is engaged in indium phosphide substrate business. After verification, the company's current main business does not include indium phosphide substrate business, nor does it have related revenue or profit, and investors are advised to be mindful of investment risks.

headlines.title: 上交所终止阳光集团发行上市审核
headlines.summary: 据上交所官网，因山西阳光焦化集团股份有限公司及其保荐人中信证券股份有限公司撤回发行上市申请，根据《上海证券交易所股票发行上市审核规则》第六十三条有关规定，上交所终止其发行上市审核。

headlines.title: 中证协启动专业人员水平测试全行业调研 测试体系迎优化窗口
headlines.summary: 中国证券业协会近日在行业内发布通知，就证券行业专业人员水平评价测试开展全行业问卷调研。据悉，中证协此次同步面向证券公司与2026年以来参加过证券行业水平测试的从业人员发放双向问卷，围绕测试内容合理性与认可度、测试内容与监管导向及行业发展的适配度、测试组织运行效率、对专项测试的优化建议等核心维度征集意见。

headlines.title_en: SAC launches industry-wide survey on professional competency tests, opening a window to optimize the testing framework
headlines.summary_en: The Securities Association of China recently issued a notice within the industry, conducting an industry-wide questionnaire survey on the professional competency evaluation test for securities industry professionals. It is understood that the association simultaneously distributed two-way questionnaires to securities firms and practitioners who participated in securities industry proficiency tests since 2026, soliciting opinions on core dimensions including the reasonableness and recognition of test content, alignment of test content with regulatory guidance and industry development, test organization operational efficiency, and optimization suggestions for specialized tests.
